titleSq: Banesë në shitje në Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Apartment for sale in Fushë Kosovë
descriptionSq:
Ofrohet per shitje banese me siperfaqe 94.35 m², me lokacion ne Rrugen Zahir Pajaziti, Fushe Kosove.
Ndertim nga Tehno Home.

Ka kete renditje te hapesirave te brendshme: qendrim ditor, kuzhine, 2 dhoma gjumi, nje banjo, nje WC dhe 2 ballkone. Banesa posedon gjithashtu rreth 66 m² tarrace, e cila nuk eshte e perfshire ne planin teknik.

Kontrata behet tek noteri direkt me kompanine ndertuese.
Punimet perfundojne ne Qershor 2026.
Sistemi i ngrohjes eshte elektrik nen dysheme.
Banesa ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar, afer sherbimeve publike dhe private.
descriptionEn:
An apartment of 94.35 m² is offered for sale, located on Rruga Zahir Pajaziti, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Tehno Home.

It has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms, one bathroom, one WC and 2 balconies. The apartment also has approximately 66 m² of terrace, which is not included in the technical plan.
It is located on the 4th floor.

The contract is signed at the notary directly with the construction company.
The works will be completed in June 2026.
The heating system is electric underfloor heating.
The apartment is located in a developed area, near public and private services.
